name: damage constitutive relation
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将材料损伤变量与应力应变等力学响应联系的关系。
usage_overview: 损伤本构关系在混凝土轨道板动力模型中用于联系应力、应变与材料退化，据此更新轨道板刚度，将损伤影响纳入列车—轨道—桥梁动力相互作用分析。

complete_examples.text: The first step to achieve the damage research of concrete slabs is to construct or introduce the damage constitutive relation models.
In this numerical simulation, the related parameters used in the damage constitutive relation are ascertained by the experiments [18].
